Default Prove-Up Hearing
Off Calendar Apr-01-2010 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Comm. William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Karen Farnsworth, #5162.

Jonathan Ayers, Esq. appeared for plaintiff DCFS Trust.
Chip Kriby, Senior Dealer Relationship Manager for plaintiff, was placed under oath and examined.
No appearance by defendant Harmit Singh Mann.
Defaults were entered against defendant on October 28, 2009 & March 29, 2010.
Doe defendants were dismissed on October 28, 2009.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff DCFS Trust, and against the Defaulted Defendant Harmit Singh Mann as follows:

Damages/Principal - $47,083.87.
Prejudgment Interest - $3,944.34.
Attorney Fees - $2,825.00.
Costs - $434.00, for a total judgment in the amount of $54,287.71.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
